SELECT substr(ym.Date,1,4) AS year, ROUND(SUM(ym.Consumption),2) AS total_consumption_czk
FROM debit_card_specializing.yearmonth ym
JOIN debit_card_specializing.customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY substr(ym.Date,1,4)
ORDER BY total_consumption_czk DESC
LIMIT 10
